description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 1+1 ne Astir.
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 88.61 m2, nga te cilat 75.69 m2 jane pjese e siperfaqes se brendeshme dhe 12.91 m2 jane pjese e siperfaqes se perbashket.
Organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje bashke me kendin e gatimit dhe te ngrenies, 1 dhome gjumi, 1 tualet dhe 1 ballkon.
Apartamenti eshte pjese e nje pallati te ri ne ndertim, i cili perfundon ne dhjetor te vitit 2026.
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Astir. The apartment has a total surface of 88.61 m2, of which 75.69 m2 are part of the internal surface and 12.91 m2 are part of the common surface. It is organized in a living room with a cooking and dining area, 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom and 1 balcony. The apartment is part of a new building under construction, which will be completed in December 2026.
